findingDetails.title: External path correctness is source-evidenced but CI and hook execution are not replayed
findingDetails.evidence: Workflow installs from workspace root and builds shared/runtime, freshness workflow invokes moved sweep path, but CI, hook adapters and mirror checks are not executable within this lineage.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replay workflow-equivalent install/build and configured hook/mirror checks in an authorized verification session.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct reads of both workflows, plugin import, doctor route and worktree shared-path list.

findingDetails.title: Worktree provisioning and CI ownership are distributed without one current-state contract
findingDetails.evidence: Worktree helper shares runtime/cli dist and node_modules while CI installs at workspace root and builds runtime; packet does not state which process owns shared-artifact freshness.
findingDetails.recommendation: Document shared artifact ownership and freshness expectations in a scoped operator-facing contract.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct comparison of worktree shared paths and workflow install/build steps.
